about: Hand-written semantic perturbation programs (stand-ins for model-proposed ones; same format AIProgramProposer.parse() accepts). Ops and argument ranges: veritask.data.engine.PRIMITIVES. Placeholders: $held, $held_arm, $active_arm, $target, $object:<i>.

programs.name: colleague_moves_target
programs.description: A person slides the target (goal region / tray / appliance) 5 cm toward the robot and turns it by 10 deg while the robot is working.

programs.name: grasp_slip_with_nudge
programs.description: The grasp slips: the gripper opens for a moment and the falling object is nudged sideways, then the gripper closes again (on nothing).

programs.name: arm_bumped_up_and_aside
programs.description: Someone bumps the moving arm: its tool point is displaced 6 cm up and 5 cm sideways (grasp state unchanged).
